note: One answer per post to the four originality questions. Stored BEFORE the post goes out, because a rationale written afterwards is a rationalisation.
law: A post with no stored originality claim does not ship. There is no auto-pass and no default answer.

2026-08-22-arita-blastoise.contribution: We identified that a single illustrator's work bookends twenty-four years of the game and paired the two cards that prove it, by joining the artist field across two sets nobody cross-references.
2026-08-22-arita-blastoise.derivedFrom: data/artists.json — byArtist['Mitsuhiro Arita'] links the Celebrations Classic Collection Charizard to the 151 Blastoise ex. The artist field is also carried on every card in data/card-bios.json.
2026-08-22-arita-blastoise.plainTextVersion: The artist who drew the 1999 Base Set Charizard also drew the Blastoise ex in 2023. Twenty-four years, same hand, and almost nobody notices.

2026-08-23-charmander-late-night-check-i.contribution: We cropped the card art and wrote a two-word mood hook over it.
2026-08-23-charmander-late-night-check-i.derivedFrom: nothing — the card was chosen for its art, not for anything in our data

2026-08-23-slakoth-2am-coding.contribution: We surfaced that this card's own printed attack name is Take It Easy, which turns the card itself into the joke about coding at 2am — the pun is in the catalogue, not in the caption.
2026-08-23-slakoth-2am-coding.derivedFrom: data/card-bios.json — attacks field on the Surging Sparks 2024 Slakoth reads ['Take It Easy']
2026-08-23-slakoth-2am-coding.plainTextVersion: Slakoth's attack is officially called Take It Easy. That is a real printed attack name on a real card.

2026-08-23-sunflora-only-good-vibes-pass.contribution: We matched the card's printed lore — Sunflora is always looking in the direction of the sun — to a caption about passing good things along and watching them grow.
2026-08-23-sunflora-only-good-vibes-pass.derivedFrom: data/card-bios.json — lore field on the Twilight Masquerade 2024 Sunflora reads 'Since it converts sunlight into energy, it is always looking in the direction of the sun'
2026-08-23-sunflora-only-good-vibes-pass.plainTextVersion: Sunflora's card text says it spends its life turning to face the sun. Pass it along and see it grow.

pmt8ossvc.contribution: Tyler read the artwork itself — a dog staring at a picnic table covered in sandwiches — and wrote a five-word pun that means both the bread on the table and go and earn.
pmt8ossvc.derivedFrom: the artwork, not our data. No field in this repo describes what is drawn on a card; the catalogue holds printed text only.

pmt8zygtt.contribution: A 25-year illustrator continuity surfaced from our own catalogue: Naoyo Kimura drew Magmar in Neo Genesis (2000) and again in Journey Together (2025), verified card-by-card against the printed credit line, not restated from another account.
pmt8zygtt.plainTextVersion: Naoyo Kimura drew this Magmar in 2000. Then drew it again in 2025.
